nonBlocking.issue: recoverAbandonedRuns increments historyWritten on any resolved promise from discoveryRunsLogger.append, but append resolves with { ok: false, reason } instead of rejecting on logging failures, counting unwritten rows as written.

GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN_SAFE_RUN_MS applies a fixed 50-minute duration cap for runs using request-scoped Google access tokens without verifying the remaining token TTL, allowing an aged token to expire before the run completes.

discoveryProfile in discovery-webhook-request.v1 schema allows sourcePreset alongside arbitrary additionalProperties without validating mutual exclusivity against legacy enabledSources at the schema level.
